operations.comment: ; Round 02 current-source commentary. Physical offsets include the 16-byte header.
; CPU aliases require the effective physical PRG bank context printed at each code section.
; Mapper selectors are distinct from physical 8 KiB bank indices. Static code does not imply natural execution.
; iNES header: mapper 1, eight 16 KiB PRG units and sixteen 8 KiB CHR units; no trainer.
; Code, physical $000010..$00003E, PRG bank 0; CPU $8000.
; Keep this actor through scene clears. Clear the nametable, load banked graphics, select
; a palette and sound, then install an inline animation descriptor. X selects one of
; twelve actor slots.
; Data, physical $00003E..$000040.
; Little-endian pointer consumed from the caller return address by InstallInlineAnimation; execution
; resumes after both bytes.
; Code, physical $000040..$00007C, PRG bank 0; CPU $8030.
; Initialize fixed-point velocity and title display state. Yield between physics steps
; until the vertical pixel position reaches $92; clamp it to $94 and replace the
; animation.
; Yield one tick, apply gravity and integrate until the landing threshold.
; Set the final vertical pixel to $94 and install the landing animation.
; Data, physical $00007C..$00007E.
; Little-endian pointer consumed from the caller return address by InstallInlineAnimation; execution
; resumes after both bytes.
; Code, physical $00007E..$000092, PRG bank 0; CPU $806E.
; Yield and advance the random generator until the actor crosses horizontal pixel $C3,
; then install the next animation.
; The actor has crossed horizontal pixel $C3.
; Little-endian pointer consumed from the caller return address by InstallInlineAnimation; execution
; resumes after both bytes.
; Code, physical $000094..$000117. CPU $8084; effective PRG banks [0, 1, 14, 15].
; Title demonstration: launch with velocity (+1.5,-2.5), yield between motion/gravity updates and
; allow held input to skip. Crossing the right edge changes the backdrop; the next fall clamps at
; Y=$C4 before installing the next animation.
; Little-endian pointer consumed from the caller return address by InstallInlineAnimation; execution
; resumes after both bytes.
; Code, physical $000119..$000136. CPU $8109; effective PRG banks [0, 1, 14, 15].
; Play sound $70 and advance the demonstration until X reaches $46. Held input takes the title exit;
; the inline pointer selects the next animation.
; Little-endian pointer consumed from the caller return address by InstallInlineAnimation; execution
; resumes after both bytes.
; Code, physical $000138..$000175. CPU $8128; effective PRG banks [0, 1, 14, 15].
; Set velocity (+1,-3.0625), update once per yield, then wait for descent past Y=$AB. Clamp to $AD and
; switch animation. Input can skip the entire sequence.
; Little-endian pointer consumed from the caller return address by InstallInlineAnimation; execution
; resumes after both bytes.
; Code, physical $000177..$00018F. CPU $8167; effective PRG banks [0, 1, 14, 15].
; Run until X reaches $A0, yielding every tick; held input exits and the normal path installs the next
; inline animation.
; Data, physical $00018F..$000191.
; Little-endian pointer consumed from the caller return address by InstallInlineAnimation; execution
; resumes after both bytes.
; Code, physical $000191..$0001CA. CPU $8181; effective PRG banks [0, 1, 14, 15].
; Launch rightward at (+1,-2.0625), integrate with the local gravity helper, then clamp the fall at
; Y=$C4. Held input skips the demonstration.
; Data, physical $0001CA..$0001CC.
; Little-endian pointer consumed from the caller return address by InstallInlineAnimation; execution
; resumes after both bytes.
; Code, physical $0001CC..$0001E4. CPU $81BC; effective PRG banks [0, 1, 14, 15].
; Wait until X reaches $DC, with an input exit each tick, then consume the next animation pointer.
; Data, physical $0001E4..$0001E6.
; Little-endian pointer consumed from the caller return address by InstallInlineAnimation; execution
; resumes after both bytes.
; Code, physical $0001E6..$000260. CPU $81D6; effective PRG banks [0, 1, 14, 15].
; Jump beyond the right edge and clear the screen between yielded ticks. Load the second backdrop and
; palette, restart X at zero and fall to Y=$B4 before advancing animation.
; Little-endian pointer consumed from the caller return address by InstallInlineAnimation; execution
; resumes after both bytes.
; Code, physical $000262..$00027F. CPU $8252; effective PRG banks [0, 1, 14, 15].
; Play sound $6F and run to X=$46, allowing held input to leave the demonstration.
; Data, physical $00027F..$000281.
; Little-endian pointer consumed from the caller return address by InstallInlineAnimation; execution
; resumes after both bytes.
; Code, physical $000281..$0002BE. CPU $8271; effective PRG banks [0, 1, 14, 15].
; Jump with velocity (+1,-3.0625), wait for descent and clamp at Y=$A6. Input exits; the normal path
; installs the next animation.
; Data, physical $0002BE..$0002C0.
; Little-endian pointer consumed from the caller return address by InstallInlineAnimation; execution
; resumes after both bytes.
; Code, physical $0002C0..$0002D8. CPU $82B0; effective PRG banks [0, 1, 14, 15].
; Run to X=$A0 before changing animation; yield and test held input each tick.
; Data, physical $0002D8..$0002DA.
; Little-endian pointer consumed from the caller return address by InstallInlineAnimation; execution
; resumes after both bytes.
; Code, physical $0002DA..$000313. CPU $82CA; effective PRG banks [0, 1, 14, 15].
; Launch at (+1,-2.0625), fall to Y=$B4 and install the next animation. Held input skips to the title
; menu.
; Little-endian pointer consumed from the caller return address by InstallInlineAnimation; execution
; resumes after both bytes.
; Code, physical $000315..$00032D. CPU $8305; effective PRG banks [0, 1, 14, 15].
; Run to X=$DC, yielding each tick and honoring the common input exit.
; Data, physical $00032D..$00032F.
; Little-endian pointer consumed from the caller return address by InstallInlineAnimation; execution
; resumes after both bytes.
; Code, physical $00032F..$000366. CPU $831F; effective PRG banks [0, 1, 14, 15].
; Make the final rightward jump. When the pixel coordinate crosses $FD, advance its extension and
; leave through the common title transition; held input exits earlier.
; Code, physical $000366..$0003AF, PRG bank 0; CPU $8356.
; Add $0028 to vertical velocity. On reaching integer speed four, clear the fractional
; speed. The following routine integrates both axes with signed high-byte extension.
; Return with vertical speed updated.
; Add signed 16-bit velocities into three-byte positions. The first byte is fractional,
; the second pixel, and the third signed screen extension.
; Propagate vertical carry with sign extension before integrating the horizontal axis.
; Finish the horizontal position's signed high byte.
; Data, physical $0003AF..$0003B5.
; Inspected non-code data. Title/event resource neighborhood; inspected small-value, bit-mask,
; pointer/coordinate or repeated tile/attribute patterns. Exact subtable layout/unused frame selection
; unresolved. Specific table schema and original use remain unresolved.

; Delay then little-endian frame pointer. High delay bits select optional extension fields; the

; Delay then little-endian frame pointer. High delay bits select optional extension fields; the

; Zero-delay animation redirect followed by a little-endian animation pointer; this is data control

; Delay then little-endian frame pointer. High delay bits select optional extension fields; the

; Delay then little-endian frame pointer. High delay bits select optional extension fields; the

; Delay then little-endian frame pointer. High delay bits select optional extension fields; the

; Delay then little-endian frame pointer. High delay bits select optional extension fields; the

; Zero-delay animation redirect followed by a little-endian animation pointer; this is data control

; Delay then little-endian frame pointer. High delay bits select optional extension fields; the

; Zero-delay animation redirect followed by a little-endian animation pointer; this is data control

; Delay then little-endian frame pointer. High delay bits select optional extension fields; the

; Zero-delay animation redirect followed by a little-endian animation pointer; this is data control

; Data, physical $0003FD..$000400.
; Delay then little-endian frame pointer. High delay bits select optional extension fields; the

; Delay then little-endian frame pointer. High delay bits select optional extension fields; the

; Zero-delay animation redirect followed by a little-endian animation pointer; this is data control

; Code, physical $000409..$000440. CPU $83F9; effective PRG banks [0, 1, 14, 15].
; Play the title transition sound, disable the old animation/NMI update state and hide the actor.
; After a yielded clear, select title CHR banks and graphics, then install the inline metasprite.
; Disable demo updates and hide its old animation before loading title-menu resources.
; Little-endian metasprite pointer consumed by the inline sprite installer; the next opcode excludes
; these two data bytes.
; Code, physical $000442..$000450. CPU $8432; effective PRG banks [0, 1, 14, 15].
; Position the cursor at ($29,$40), initialize its display state and consume the inline sprite
; descriptor.
; Data, physical $000450..$00045B.
; Positioned inline tile text; coordinate/header bytes precede the terminated tile stream.
; Code, physical $00045B..$000478. CPU $844B; effective PRG banks [0, 1, 14, 15].
; Fade to palette 2, clear the timer and selection phase, select the initial cursor Y and install the
; inline NMI hook.
; Data, physical $000478..$00047A.
; Little-endian NMI hook pointer. Zero disables the hook; a nonzero target requires the caller bank
; contract.
; Code, physical $00047A..$00047F. CPU $846A; effective PRG banks [0, 1, 14, 15].
; Play sound $68 for a changed title selection; continuation rejoins the existing menu logic.
; Code, physical $00047F..$00050D, PRG bank 0; CPU $846F.
; Build the first five OAM entries around the moving title actor. Wait for sprite-zero hit
; to clear, then dispatch the three selection states using newly pressed buttons.
; Do not enter menu input work until the previous sprite-zero hit has cleared.
; State zero first handles navigation input.
; Code, physical $00050D..$000521. CPU $84FD; effective PRG banks [0, 1, 14, 15].
; Toggle the two-state additional mode, update cursor Y from the selected row and rejoin the menu
; refresh.
; Code, physical $000521..$000539, PRG bank 0; CPU $8511.
; A confirm input advances the menu state, moves the cursor to its table position and
; draws three inline tile blocks.
; Data, physical $000539..$00053B.
; Little-endian rectangle pointer removed from the stacked return address. The following code begins
; after the two-byte argument.
; Code, physical $00053B..$000542, PRG bank 0; CPU $852B.
; Continue the accepted selection's second tile block; the following two-byte pointer is a stack-aware
; inline rectangle argument.
; Little-endian rectangle pointer removed from the stacked return address. The following code begins
; after the two-byte argument.
; Code, physical $000544..$00054B, PRG bank 0; CPU $8534.
; Continue the accepted selection's third tile block; its inline rectangle pointer is data and
; execution resumes beyond it.
; Data, physical $00054B..$00054D.
; Little-endian rectangle pointer removed from the stacked return address. The following code begins
; after the two-byte argument.
; Code, physical $00054D..$00059B, PRG bank 0; CPU $853D.
; Mark initial selection accepted. In state one, navigation toggles the two-way choice,
; then confirmation either edits the password or advances when the mode flag permits it.
; All handled title choices join the split-screen frame tail.
; State one toggles the two-way cursor and tests confirmation.
; Start or an action button can accept the mode; the actor choice controls the password
; path.
; Only advance the state when the additional mode flag is nonzero.
; Increment the selection state and draw its next tile block.
; Data, physical $00059B..$00059D.
; Little-endian rectangle pointer removed from the stacked return address. The following code begins
; after the two-byte argument.
; Code, physical $00059D..$0005A4. CPU $858D; effective PRG banks [0, 1, 14, 15].
; Draw the inline rectangle at tile position ($12,$10), then resume after its pointer argument.
; Data, physical $0005A4..$0005A6.
; Little-endian rectangle pointer removed from the stacked return address. The following code begins
; after the two-byte argument.
; Code, physical $0005A6..$0005B1. CPU $8596; effective PRG banks [0, 1, 14, 15].
; Mark the title selection accepted, swap player state and rejoin the title display update.
; Code, physical $0005B1..$0005BA, PRG bank 0; CPU $85A1.
; Test navigation in the final title state and play feedback. The continuation toggles the two-state
; selection and updates its cursor position.
; Code, physical $0005BA..$0005CB. CPU $85AA; effective PRG banks [0, 1, 14, 15].
; Toggle the actor's two-state selection phase and select its cursor Y from the companion table.
; Code, physical $0005CB..$0005DA, PRG bank 0; CPU $85BB.
; Test confirmation and action buttons before joining the shared title exit or frame tail.
; Code, physical $0005DA..$0005E5. CPU $85CA; effective PRG banks [0, 1, 14, 15].
; A nonzero title phase opens the alternative title panel; both paths rejoin the same title refresh.
; Code, physical $0005E5..$000663, PRG bank 0; CPU $85D5.
; The signed exit marker terminates the title loop.
; Synchronize the scroll split to the current sprite-zero hit.
; Fixed instruction delay places the scroll write below the split.
; Compare the 16-bit strip timer with $0132.
; Read controllers after the timed display work and test the exit marker.
; Run mode-dependent setup, play transition sounds and install the next frame callback.
; Play transition sound and stage the palette/scene change.
; Little-endian NMI hook pointer. Zero disables the hook; a nonzero target requires the caller bank
; contract.
; Code, physical $000665..$0006C5, PRG bank 0; CPU $8655.
; Clear event selection, completion mask and counters. Compare the password accumulator
; with six codes to choose level and five or ten lives; unrecognized codes select level
; zero and five lives. Preserve the level in both current/displayed fields.
; Y contains selected level and X the selected life count.
; Code, physical $0006C5..$0006FF. CPU $86B5; effective PRG banks [0, 1, 14, 15].
; Match six accepted password bytes to level 1..3 and five/ten lives; other values select level zero
; and five lives. Restore the current actor X after using X as the life-count result.
; Code, physical $0006FF..$000716, PRG bank 0; CPU $86EF.
; Play selection sound and clear the actor choice. The alternate-player mode can invoke
; additional setup while lives remain.
; Code, physical $000716..$00071E. CPU $8706; effective PRG banks [0, 1, 14, 15].
; Swap the active player only when lives remain; a zero count follows the existing no-lives path.
; Code, physical $00071E..$00074F, PRG bank 0; CPU $870E.
; Set mapper/display parameters and load selection-screen graphics. Draw lives at tile
; coordinate (6,15), then select the appropriate player-status drawing path.
; Controller-swap mode selects the alternate status layout.
; Code, physical $00074F..$000758. CPU $873F; effective PRG banks [0, 1, 14, 15].
; Swap player state, load the first numeric panel, then return to the common panel sequence.
; Code, physical $000758..$00075B, PRG bank 0; CPU $8748.
; Use the shared player-status renderer; adjacent inline rectangle arguments are excluded from CPU
; flow.
; Code, physical $00075B..$000764. CPU $874B; effective PRG banks [0, 1, 14, 15].
; Swap player state around the second numeric-panel setup so each display uses the intended player's
; counters.
; Swap the active player back after drawing the companion panel.
; Code, physical $000764..$000793, PRG bank 0; CPU $8754.
; The displayed level is the stored zero-based level plus one.
; Tile text terminated by the first zero byte; the inline consumer adjusts the return address past the
; terminator.
; Code, physical $000796..$00079D. CPU $8786; effective PRG banks [0, 1, 14, 15].
; Draw the following zero-terminated inline tiles at ($13,$1F); the consumer skips their data bytes

; Data, physical $00079D..$0007A0.
; Tile text terminated by the first zero byte; the inline consumer adjusts the return address past the

; Code, physical $0007A0..$0007A3. CPU $8790; effective PRG banks [0, 1, 14, 15].
; Rejoin the common briefing continuation after the first inline text.
; Code, physical $0007A3..$0007AA, PRG bank 0; CPU $8793.

; Tile text terminated by the first zero byte; the inline consumer adjusts the return address past the

; Code, physical $0007AD..$0007B4. CPU $879D; effective PRG banks [0, 1, 14, 15].
; Draw the alternative inline tile text at ($13,$1F); its first zero ends the argument.

; Tile text terminated by the first zero byte; the inline consumer adjusts the return address past the

; Code, physical $0007B7..$0007BA. CPU $87A7; effective PRG banks [0, 1, 14, 15].
; Rejoin the common briefing continuation after the alternative inline text.
; Code, physical $0007BA..$0007C1, PRG bank 0; CPU $87AA.
; Draw the single-player prompt at tile coordinate (11,31), consuming inline text through its first

; Data, physical $0007C1..$0007C4.
; Tile text terminated by the first zero byte; the inline consumer adjusts the return address past the

; Code, physical $0007C4..$0007D3, PRG bank 0; CPU $87B4.
; Restore the current actor and conditionally invoke player setup when its choice flag is

; Set the actor phase to one and re-enter the level briefing logic.
; Code, physical $0007DB..$000805, PRG bank 0; CPU $87CB.
; Finish mode setup and choose the selection-screen palette.
; A changed level installs transition animation instead of immediately spawning selection

; Remember the changed level and install its transition animation.
; Little-endian pointer consumed from the caller return address by InstallInlineAnimation; execution

; Data, physical $00083B..$00083D.
; Little-endian pointer consumed from the caller return address by InstallInlineAnimation; execution

; Little-endian pointer consumed from the caller return address by InstallInlineAnimation; execution

; Data, physical $00092E..$000930.

; Code, physical $0009CD..$000A1E, PRG bank 0; CPU $89BD.
; Yield while accepting navigation, skip completed events and blink the selected icon from
; the NMI counter. Confirmation plays feedback, fades out, removes nonpersistent actors
; and loads graphics indexed by level*5+event. The final drawing command consumes inline
; coordinates and text.
; NMI-counter bit two alternates available/completed icon drawing paths.
; Draw the completed-style icon during the opposite blink phase.
; Start/A/B confirm; otherwise continue selection animation.
; Confirm the selection and prepare the event screen.
; Shared entry for ordinary selected events and the final event. Requires the surrounding
; scene/actor contracts; direct PC entry from menu previously froze.
; Data, physical $000A1E..$000A31.
; Positioned inline tile text; coordinate/header bytes precede the terminated tile stream.
; Code, physical $000A31..$000AC5, PRG bank 0; CPU $8A21.
; Select the event's pointer table, choose one of eight entries from the random generator
; and draw its tile rectangle. Select the event palette, cycle three palette commands at
; timer values 0,6,12, and wait for held input.
; Skip two bytes for each random choice index, carrying into the pointer high byte.
; Advance the second byte with carry into the pointer high byte.
; Repeat the two-byte skip for the remaining random choice index.
; Load a little-endian pointer to the selected tile-rectangle descriptor.
; Adjust the anchor for descriptor height, then queue and flush the rectangle.
; Cycle three inline palette changes while waiting for input.
; Timer six selects the second palette command.
; Timer twelve resets to $FA and selects the third palette command.
; Any held primary-controller input exits the description loop.
; Apply the initial inline palette command when the timer wraps to zero.
; Data, physical $000AC5..$000ACB.
; Destination followed by palette colors through the first negative byte. The inline consumer resumes
; beyond that terminator.
; Code, physical $000ACB..$000AD1, PRG bank 0; CPU $8ABB.
; Return to the input check after the preceding inline palette data; the second palette
; command follows here.
; Apply the middle inline palette command.
; Data, physical $000AD1..$000AD7.
; Destination followed by palette colors through the first negative byte. The inline consumer resumes
; beyond that terminator.
; Code, physical $000AD7..$000ADA. CPU $8AC7; effective PRG banks [0, 1, 14, 15].
; Continue the parent completion scheduler at its existing shared decision block.
; Code, physical $000ADA..$000ADD, PRG bank 0; CPU $8ACA.
; Queue the third inline palette stream through its first negative terminator; its following bytes
; resume CPU execution.
; Data, physical $000ADD..$000AE3.
; Destination followed by palette colors through the first negative byte. The inline consumer resumes
; beyond that terminator.
; Code, physical $000AE3..$000AE6. CPU $8AD3; effective PRG banks [0, 1, 14, 15].
; Continue the same completion scheduler after the second child allocation.
; Code, physical $000AE6..$000B2F, PRG bank 0; CPU $8AD6.
; Fade out and create the selected event's entry actor.
; Yield until the spawned actor's active bit clears.
; Code, physical $000B2F..$000B3F. CPU $8B1F; effective PRG banks [0, 1, 14, 15].
; Remove transient actors, clear pause state, yield once and install the inline NMI hook for the
